canonical_statement: Every nonzero finitely generated commutative algebra R over a field k admits an injective k-algebra map from a polynomial algebra in finitely many variables to R such that R is finite as a module over that polynomial algebra; contravariantly, Spec R has a finite morphism to the corresponding affine space over k.
